title: Newmark Assists KBS in the Sale of the Largest Multi-Tenant Office Sale in San Jose, California Since 2020
summary: Newmark announces the Company has assisted KBS with the sale of The Almaden, a three-building, 416,126-square-foot office campus at 1, 55 and 99 Almaden Boulevard in Downtown San Jose.
body_markdown: Newmark announces the Company has assisted KBS with the sale of The Almaden, a three-building, 416,126-square-foot office campus at 1, 55 and 99 Almaden Boulevard in Downtown San Jose.
